brief:
Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has funded an all-expenses-paid tour for American state legislators, Dawn reported. The "50 States 1 Israel" program, which ran September 14-18, 2025, marked the first such initiative by the Israeli state targeting U.S. state-level officials. The trips are marketed as educational exchanges.

The Israeli government has offered subsidized travel to American officials since the 2000s as part of efforts to build political support. The September tour took place as Israel continues military operations in Gaza.

title: Israel funds all-expenses-paid trips for U.S. state lawmakers
